purpose: Document Anantapur's official Andhra Pradesh cadastral service, local district/municipal links, DILRMP status context, and bounded anonymous requests while separating registry evidence from geometry and runtime qualification.
assessment: The official Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha service establishes a state cadastral-map source, while the official Anantapuramu district portal links MeeBhoomi land records and the official municipal page exposes a GIS-map shell. The bounded live Bhunaksha request timed out before current JavaScript/configuration or a parcel API could be inspected. No safe native ID, schema, CRS, or polygon geometry was verified, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official AP Survey, Settlements and Land Records Bhunaksha service and official Anantapur district/municipal land-map links. This establishes official service evidence but not citywide geometry completeness or title/ownership information.

attempts: Performed separate English and Telugu first-party discovery queries and recorded actual result URLs.
Opened the official Bhunaksha AP result; it redirected to the AP state route and described cadastral mapping, geo-referenced spatial data, and Survey, Settlements and Land Records operation.

Attempted an anonymous GET of the current Bhunaksha AP route https://bhunaksha.ap.gov.in/bhunakshalpm/28/index.jsp; the request timed out after 10 seconds before HTML, JavaScript/configuration, API route, schema, CRS, ID, or geometry could be retained.
Loaded the official Telugu Anantapuramu district portal; it identifies district administration and links citizens to MeeBhoomi land records.
Loaded the official Anantapur municipal GIS-map page; its map shell and base-layer controls were visible, but no parcel layer or parcel response was exposed in bounded inspection.
Reviewed the official DILRMP Anantapur status result as national status context only; it is not treated as a local parcel geometry endpoint.

Did not submit the WUP latitude/longitude to a local endpoint, did not shift the point, did not request owner/address/title/account/tax fields, did not log in, did not bypass CAPTCHA/Cloudflare, and did not disable TLS verification.
